_comment: Mission 3 - Delta-only rules (inherits from baseline layers)

mission_meta.title: Special Operation: Agent Transport to Scarpa Flow, North Scotland
mission_meta.objective: Surface at the X hex at the end of your U-Boat Phase to drop the agent, then exit the map in the direction of the red arrow.

rules.notes: U-Boat must begin this mission at Medium depth — cannot choose starting depth
U-Boat must be SURFACED at the X hex at the END of the U-Boat Phase to complete the drop. Being there mid-phase does not count.

sections.label: Merchant Ships Phase
sections.note: No merchant ship in Mission 3 — skip Phase 2 entirely
